**Community name**
The name of the community.

**Community description**
A brief description of this community.

**Invite link**
An invite link to this community. This must not expire and **cannot be a vanity link**.

**Why should this discord community be added?**
Explain briefly why you think this community is a good fit for this resource site. Why is it relevant to C++?
